policy: The frozen benchmark is not rewritten after a source-identity error is discovered. This erratum preserves the original record and supersedes only the affected transport identity for future execution.

affected.reason: A post-freeze source-identity check found that the recorded dataset reference did not match the currently observed official/current Hugging Face dataset identity.

correction.reason: Gated dataset bytes and an exact immutable file-level identity were not established through the available runtime.

authority_consequence: No Round-016 IsoSci execution result is valid or claimed.
The MIR benchmark contract and support implementation are unaffected.
Any future IsoSci execution must start from a newly frozen corrected packet after exact access, revision/file identity, split identity and hidden-label policy are established.
The original wrong reference remains in the frozen benchmark as negative provenance; it must not be silently erased.
lesson: Benchmark and dataset identity are epistemic coordinates, not transport trivia. Source-name familiarity or a plausible dataset identifier is insufficient evidence of corpus identity.
